title: Late Charges on Deduction Schedules Reinstated by a Returned Remittance — Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement
content:
**Amount for a period.** The late charge for a period is the greater of the tier's minimum late charge and the tier's late charge rate of the item's open amount on the first day of that period, rounded to the nearest cent, for every overdue item except the employer-liable shortfall notice and the reinstated deduction schedule that the provisions on those two late charges select; the late charge on that reinstated deduction schedule is the one these provisions settle. Under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement a deduction schedule is reinstated when a remittance against it comes back unpaid and is reversed by a remittance return.

## Assessing the charge

The desk assesses it with `assess_return_late_charge_9954ff84`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it, for a verified employer contact. It assesses one late charge for the current late-charge period on a deduction schedule whose remittance came back unpaid. One call books one late charge, invoice line `late_charge`, pointing to the deduction schedule named, billing the current calendar month and carrying the due date given, and raises the program charges the employer currently owes on the agreement by the charge. The employer sees the late charge on its program statement.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the reference number of the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, read from the agreement record returned by the program agreement finder |
| `related_entry_id` | the settlement entry reference number of the deduction schedule being charged, read from the settlement entries returned by the program settlement finder |
| `charge_amount` | the late charge, in US dollars, a number with 2 decimal places; any further decimals are rounded half up to the cent by the tool |
| `due_date` | the date the late charge is due, written YYYY-MM-DD as a calendar date with no time or time zone; never empty |

## Return

A single text line: "Late charge assessed: <amount> USD on deduction schedule <related_entry_id>, due <due_date>, charge reference <charge reference>; program charges owed now <amount> USD." The amounts are US dollars with two decimals, the charge reference is the new billing entry reference number, and the last figure is the agreement's program charges owed with the charge included. A receipt line beginning with "Late charge assessed" means the charge is booked.
